plain: To prove that something is real, true or genuine.

webster.text: To render authentic; to give authority to, by the proof, attestation, or formalities, required by law, or sufficient to entitle to credit.

example.quote: And I call upon the gentleman who mentioned it to authenticate the fact.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. BISHOP, January 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
